0022600168.text: The Utah Jazz (1-5, 0-1 on the road) visit the San Antonio Spurs (3-2) for the Jazz's seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah having lost four straight and sitting 14th in the West and 3.5 games back in the Northwest. San Antonio has won three straight, sits 8th in the West and is 2 games back in the Southwest. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
